source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixed front-end thread selection handler chooses empty/single/multiple message display directly; multiple selection passes getSelectedMsgHdrs to displayMessages. Fixed command-updater methods still handle post-delete selection and virtual-folder loading. The direct collapsed-thread selection code now depends on OperateOnMsgsInCollapsedThreads and row/thread flags; it no longer checks mSummarizeFailed. The stale nearby comment still describes the removed failure condition. A focused documentation proposal is to describe the actual preference/tree contract and row flags instead; no comment edit is made. The interface retains the two deletion callbacks. Removing the old backend summary hook does not mean multi-message presentation disappeared. The deleted summarization test was skip-if true already, so removal is not proof equivalent active scenarios were replaced. The changed junk test removes an unused command-updater object and await of its method property (without calling it), while retaining folder-added and move/copy completion listener promises. Current source keeps those meaningful waits and adds a later injected-message task. No selection, multi-message view, junking, deletion, browser or unit test ran.
title: The removed summary-failure guard still appears in a collapsed-selection comment
